# Vendored dependencies

`phaser.min.js` — [Phaser 3](https://phaser.io/) v3.80.1, the game engine
this project is built on. Vendored locally (rather than loaded from a CDN)
so the game works with no internet connection — `index.html` can be opened
directly with zero setup, offline included.

Phaser is distributed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/phaserjs/phaser/blob/master/license.txt).
Unmodified build, pulled from the official npm package
(`phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js`).
